entities.name: Jurij Goličič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jurij Goličič is a Slovenian retired ice hockey player. He participated at the 2003, 2005, 2006, and 2008 IIHF World Championships as a member of the Slovenia men's national ice hockey team. He is a brother of Boštjan Goličič.
